name: kanagawa-vscode-color-theme
description: A port of the Kanagawa Neovim color theme for Visual Studio Code, including all three flavors Wave, Dragon and Lotus.
readme:
# Kanagawa Flavors

A port of the Kanagawa Neovim color scheme: **Kanagawa Wave**, Kanagawa Dragon (dark) and Kanagawa Lotus (light). After installing, reload the window and pick a theme with `Preferences: Color Theme` (Ctrl+K Ctrl+T), or set `"workbench.colorTheme": "Kanagawa Wave"` in settings.json.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
